The space
Close to everything, away from it all.  Enjoy the quiet countryside, yet have all the conveniences and entertainment of Nashville only 30 minutes away.  Clarksville is approximately 30 minutes away and the Nashville International Airport (BNA) is 40 minutes away. Of course these times are estimates dependent on traffic conditions. 

Everyday we are thankful for the post card view we enjoy. My husband Todd and I live on the upper level of the house with our French Bulldog, Indy. We recently built out the lower level of our house to welcome guests. We took much care to insulate between the floors so that we would not share noise. 

The upper and lower levels are completely separate and private including private entrances. The deck above is our outdoor space and the patio below, including the hot tub is private outdoor space for our guests. 

We enjoy meeting people but we will not make any attempt to interact with you. If you would like meet, just let us know.  With that being said, you may see us in the driveway or working in the yard or gardens. 

This is a two bedroom Guest Suite with a king bed in one bedroom and a queen in the other bedroom. Each bed will comfortably sleep two people each.  Additionally, a queen sized air mattress, complete with bedding, is also available for an additional two people.

A great stay begins with great communication. Please take a moment to make yourself and everyone staying with you aware of the following information and rules.

We have a Ring doorbell that has a camera. It is angled away from the hot tub. There is also an exterior camera on the front of the house overlooking the driveway / parking area. Cameras are not to be covered or disabled. 

We require that all adult guests be listed on the reservation and have identity verification completed on Airbnb before arrival. Please do this early since it can sometimes take awhile.  We also have a welcome board and would like to include everyone who is staying, so please message us with the first names of children and pets who will be staying. 

The minimum age to book a stay is 21 years old. 

These rules are the most strictly enforced:  
Absolutely NO use of cannabis or any illegal drugs on the property.  
No smoking or vaping inside the guest suite. You are permitted to smoke or vape outside in designated areas.
Beware that if you smoke anything inside, you will be charged an additional $250. cleaning fee. 

Parties:
Even though Nashville currently seems to be the bachelorette party capital, we will not host bachelor or bachelorette parties or any party that centers around loud and drunken behavior. 

We do welcome our guests to celebrate birthdays and anniversaries, etc. Generally we only expect those listed on the reservation to be in attendance for your celebration. However, let us know if you are visiting friends or family in the area and would like to have them over for awhile. 

Generally we do not allow any open flames including candles but, if you are celebrating a birthday you are welcome to use birthday cake candles. 

Quiet Hours are between 10 p.m and 8 a.m.  You are welcome to use the patio and hot tub during these hours, we just ask that you do not play loud music or talk / laugh loudly.  

Our beautiful view is due to the fact that the house is located on a ridge overlooking a valley. You can expect steep and uneven ground if you move beyond the patio and level yard area around the patio. Proceed with caution and at your own risk.   Additionally, there are outside stairs leading to the Guest Suite.  Please consider this if you have difficulty navigating stairs. 

During mild weather it is a temptation to leave the doors open. However, bugs, lizards and small animals may come inside if you leave the doors open.  Please keep the doors closed to keep these pests and critters outside.  Thanks!

Hot Tub Rules:
We work hard to provide an exceptionally clean and balanced hot tub for your use. It is cleaned and prepared prior to each guest stay. We think you will love relaxing in it as you enjoy the view. There is a more extensive listing of hot tub rules in the guest suite but these are the essentials:
~Please shower to remove lotions and oils from your body and hair before entering the tub.
~Do not add any oils or soaps to the hot tub water. 
~No glass.  You will find plastic drink ware in the kitchen for your use. 
~Close the cover when not in use.  
~If the hot tub is misused, there will be an additional $250. cleaning fee charged. 

Dog guests: 
  ~We welcome one small dog. 
  ~Please list the dog on your reservation. An additional $50. cleaning fee will be charged.
  -Dogs must be kenneled when you are not present. We can provide a kennel for a small dog. 
  ~ Please do not allow your dog on the beds. 
  ~A potty clean up container is provided for your use. 
  ~No cats or other types of pets are allowed. 

Thank you for helping us to provide a safe and clean place for all our guests.  

We are here to help you plan for your special occasions or to simply have a fun vacation.  Please let us know if we can receive grocery orders prior to your arrival, or pick up a birthday cake and balloons. 

Be sure to check out our Guidebook on the listing. There is also a printed copy in the Home Manual on the entryway table in Guest Suite.

You are going to have a great time!

Guest access
Parking is available in the driveway in front of the “Guest Parking” sign. We can accommodate 2 vehicles. Walk down the sidewalk between the house and garage continuing down the steps to the lower level. Enter the Guest Suite through the doors beside the hot tub. 

There is a Wi-Fi connected keypad for entry. You will receive a code 24 - 48 hours prior to check-in.

Other things to note
The ridge is also filled with wildlife. In their seasons you may enjoy seeing hummingbirds, butterflies, birds, bunnies and squirrels.  Occasionally we have had deer and wild turkeys walking through the yard. You may also see hawks and eagles soaring over the valley.

If your dog is joining you, please keep them on a leash at all times. Although rare, we have seen coyotes, fox and other animals that could be a threat to your dog.  

Please feel free to walk through the gardens. Take a seat in the pollinator garden to enjoy the bees and butterflies durning the spring, summer and fall.

An old airstrip once cut through these fields, and stories still circulate about a plane that made regular trips from who-knows-where into the outskirts of Nashville. The cargo? Welcome to our private retreat. Where relaxation & warm family gatherings are in their element. This incredible home sits on 8 wooded acres just 25mins North of Nashville. It is a gated property, surrounded by nature’s privacy.
Enjoy the stunning fire pit, cook on the charcoal grill or soak in the hot tub under the stars!
With 6 sleeping rooms & as many as 17 beds to choose from, it can accommodate large families (max 22).
Enjoy our ping pong & pool tables, our arcade room & even a movie theater

The space
Enjoy the outdoor features such as our stunning fire pit illuminated by fairy lights on our grand patio. Adjacent to the fire-pit are 2 large outdoor dining tables spacious enough to comfortably seat 16 and a charcoal grill to whip up some steaks or burgers for your entire group. Read a book in our stunning 4 sided glass sun room while overlooking the woods packed with deer, turkey and other wildlife that simply meander by! After a long day exploring Nashville, Old Hickory Lake or the countless parks in the surrounding area, let your muscles relax as you soak in the 6 person hot tub on our covered veranda.

When you aren’t taking in the great outdoors, you’ll have plenty to do indoors too! The entire home was renovated in 2024 with hosting guests at the forefront of the design. In addition to having everything you need to prepare family meals, the kitchen features a stunning Island that seats 7 so you can chat while you prep! There’s a large pantry, dishwasher, microwave drawer, double oven, side-by-side fridge, induction cook-top, coffee maker and more… And when I say more, there’s an entire other full kitchen in the basement too!

The whole main level is one large open, soaring space where you can see from one side of the house to the other with an abundance of natural light throughout.
There are two main dining areas in addition to the kitchen Island. Both formal dining tables are exquisite pieces with 8 lush chairs around each.
The living room features 3 white leather couches, so please treat them with love and care (no shoes) for both your enjoyment and that of our future guests.
There is a dedicated work desk adjacent to the living room furnishings that can be elevated or lowered for your convenience.
While some of your group relax around the TV, others can enjoy a game of pool on our rustic slate bed table which has another large mounted TV and live edge bar top to rest your drinks or charge your phones at.

If you have a musician or two in the family, then feel free to utilize the Guitar mounted on the wall to sing or write songs together. After all, that’s what Nashville is all about!

There are 3 large bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a spacious laundry room also located on the main level.
The master suite is found at one end of the home and features a King Bed, a twin size day bed and twin trundle beneath (sleeps up to 4 in this room). It is an enormous room with accent walls, custom chandelier and trey ceiling. The master bathroom has double vanities, a walk-in-shower and a free-standing soaking tub. The master closet is custom designed and very spacious.
Bedroom #2 features a king bed, delightful barn wood accent wall, mounted TV and double closet. (Sleeps up to 2 people).
Bedroom #3 features 2 queen beds, mounted TV and double closet. (Sleeps up to 4 people).
Bedroom #2 & #3 are located adjacent to a guest bathroom with double vanities and a separated toilet and tub/shower area.
The laundry features large washer and drying machines, an undermounted sink, built-in ironing board, coat closet, custom bag drop with shoe storage area and even a steamer.

So now let’s explore the basement…

At the bottom of the staircase you will open the door into our den. This room features a spacious sectional couch with stunning tree trunk coffee table and end tables orientated around the decorative fireplace and flat screen TV. It is also the perfect spot for the kids (or big kids) to hang out and enjoy some great entertainment. We have multiple arcade machines, including our dueling Pac Man wall where you can try to get your name on the leaderboard with a new high score! When it’s time for bed or simply an afternoon nap, you can enjoy our 4 custom bunk beds, with reading lights and curtains to make them feel like a true hide-out! (Sleeps up to 4).

Step out into the garage area and you will see our custom flake floor, find a ping pong table ready for hours of fun or even grab the corn hole boards to take outside for some great times.

On the basement level we have another full size kitchen with fridge, freezer, dishwasher and microwave. There is a bar top to eat at and an exterior door leading to an amazing back patio with sectional couches to sit enjoy a morning cup of coffee, an evening glass of wine/beer, or simply read a good book while listening to the great outdoors. Take a few steps from this patio along the back of the home and you’ll arrive at our covered hot-tub area. The hot tub is surrounded by evening fairy lights, can seat up to 6 people and is accessed both from the basement level or from an iron staircase leading down from the sun room above.

Back indoors and to round out the basement we have an additional King bedroom suite, featuring a full bathroom with lush walk-in shower. (Sleeps up to 2)
A bunk room with 2 twin bunk beds plus additional twin trundles underneath and a large closet (sleeps up to 6). Just outside the bunk room is our full guest bathroom with tub/shower combo.

And our final feature of the basement is the movie theater. With 3 rows of leather recliners and an 85” flat screen TV, it is the perfect spot to snuggle up with a blanket and watch some movies together!

With a house set up like this, you’d expect to be tucked away in the mountains miles away from civilization, but this isn’t the case for our gated retreat. In fact, you are less than 10 minutes from most amenities you can think of, such as bars, restaurants, lake access and more. In fact there is a Publix just 5 mins down the rd for all your grocery needs.

Other areas of interest in Hendersonville, just North of Nashville include multiple local and state parks, several exquisite wedding venues along Long Hollow Pike, an abundance of golf courses and last but not least, Old Hickory Lake which has multiple marinas where you can rent boats, go fishing or even take trips on Tiki Bar Cruisers! Of course, most of the water-front restaurants feature live music throughout the peak season too!

Please note that this property is located at the end of a long driveway up a hill and there is a chance in the winter time that the concrete driveway could become icy and NOT accessible to drive on. This happens very rarely in Nashville, but in the most recent years there has tended to be around 3-7 days in the winter that such conditions have occurred. It is a long gated driveway and it is not salted. Please plan accordingly if you book to stay with us during this season by taking extra precautions and purchasing travel insurance. Middle Tennessee does not handle cold and Ice particularly well and most roads around Nashville during such winter storms are largely un-navigable.

We sincerely look forward to hosting you in the future and should you have any questions, don’t hesitate to ask.

Master Bedroom - King Bed. Additional day bed with trundle underneath (Sleeps up to 4). Flat Screen TV. En-suite bathroom with soaking tub, shower and walk-in-closet.

Bedroom #2 - King Bed. (Sleeps up to 2). Flat Screen TV. Bathroom located in the corridor outside bedroom 2&3 with double vanities and tub/shower combo.

Dedicated Bunk Room (located in Basement) - 2 Bunk Beds with pull-out trundles featuring 6 twin mattresses. (Sleeps up to 6). Large closet and full Bathroom located in the corridor outside with tub/shower combo.

Den - 4 custom built-in twin bunk beds with privacy curtains and reading lights. (Sleeps up to 4). Bathroom located down the corridor outside the bunk room with tub/shower combo.

Convenient apartment with easy parking and private entrance. The space is perfect for a single person or 2 adults, and a child or two if you have them. A cozy hideaway in a quiet neighborhood, with a small patio, garden, and creek beyond. Only 20 minutes to downtown, 15 to Vanderbilt.  

Super comfy queen bed, plus two additional sleeping options: a chaise in the bedroom, and a twin-size daybed in the the living room. Keurig coffeemaker and bottled water dispenser. Covered parking at your door.

The space
This is a separate apartment, the lower level of our home, with covered parking only a few feet from the private entrance. The main living area contains a twin-size daybed/sofa, a comfortable side chair and laptop table, gas fireplace, TV, and a kitchenette (no sink) with table and chairs. The private bath has a  shower (no tub) and colorful towels. The bedroom sports a comfy queen bed and a chaise that's perfect to use as a single bed, if you happen to have a child (or other extraneous person) with you.

There's a small convenience kitchenette, with a coffeemaker, mini-fridge, microwave, and toaster oven, as well as plenty of dishes and a handy table and chairs. But please be aware there is no stove or kitchen sink, so it's not really suitable for heavy-duty cooking.

High-speed wireless internet is available throughout the apartment, and there's a TV with broadcast stations and DVD player (not blu-ray) with assorted videos. No cable TV or streaming service, but that's no real loss--we hope the reason you've come to Nashville is to visit family or friends, or see the sights and hear some great live music!

Guest access
The apartment is private with your own entrance. Come and go as you like! You also have access to your own covered patio right outside your door. The bentwood rockers are a great place for morning coffee.
In addition, you're welcome to share with us the garden, yard, fire pit, and creek.

Other things to note
The apartment is on the lower level of our ranch home.  We have additional storage/living areas that are also on the lower level, separated from the apartment by a locked door, with a separate entrance through the garage. 

There's a tiny house on the property, and you may see someone coming and going from there. It's not part of the Airbnb.
 
We live on the first floor above you. Our children are grown, but they do visit occasionally. You'll find white noise machines in the bedroom and living room if you’re sensitive to footfall noise from the floor above you. 

This might be a good time to mention our dog Tupa. He stays with us, not you, but he does go out back with Martin a couple times a day for exercise. He's not a barker unless someone is breaking in, or he believes someone is (that's in his job description). You're welcome to pet him, but if you prefer that we keep him away from you, let us know and we will.

There's a train on the other side of the street, behind the houses. You probably won't hear it in the apartment, although many travelers regard trains as romantic.

Our reviews show that guests love our place. It's homey, as this is our home and we want it to be a welcoming space. We're usually around -- I currently work from home and Martin works part-time. That means you might see us gardening or hear us talking on the deck or smell food on the grill as we happily go about our normal lives. Those who are expecting more of a hotel room experience are better off choosing a different type of listing.

The apartment opens up to a lush garden (overly lush, at times). You might see cardinals, hummingbirds, finches, and maybe even a snapping turtle or great blue heron down by the creek. The rustic, scenic habitat is one of the charms of the apartment. We’ll do our best to provide a restful refuge for your stay in Nashville.

Instagram: @cabincreekfarmfranklin

The space
This 2 story home, while traditional on the exterior, has every modern touch and amenities on the inside. From the moment you open the door to begin your stay at Cabin Creek Farm, you'll notice that careful attention has been paid to every detail.  

The warm entryway welcomes you into the expansive, open kitchen and family living area that is the heartbeat of this home.  This comfortable, yet stylish space will no doubt be the gathering place for your family or group throughout your stay.  You can't help but come together here...whether it's over a lazy breakfast, cocktail "hour", a decadent dinner, or late night conversation.  Unwind, have fun and enjoy the relaxed style of a property that was created with your comfort and happiness in mind.  Curl up in your new favorite chair and watch a movie on the flatscreen, listen to the music of your choice on our Bluetooth sound system or, better yet, spend some time free of technology and check out our wide assortment of games and puzzles for all ages...nothing says family fun (or fun in general), like a good ole game!  

The master on the main is a beautiful oasis.  With a king bed, luxury linens and bedding, flatscreen television, plush carpet, a walk-in closet, and full bath with a jacuzzi tub...you might just want to skip the Honkey Tonks!  

Upstairs, you will be afforded as much privacy as you wish as there's a door that completely separates the first story from the second. This can be ideal for couples vacationing together, or couples/groups with children, who prefer to keep the evening going long after bedtime for the little ones.  

There on the second level, you'll find yet another beautifully appointed king room with its own flatscreen television, and a walk-in closet spacious enough to be a perfect "nursery" set up for a baby or toddler, and make it a lovely, quiet spot for your little one to get a good nights sleep or a long nap, while mom and dad are able to enjoy their vacation too.  

A third spacious bedroom is also located on the second floor.  This serene space has two plush queen beds, luxurious linens, beautiful wooded views, and a sitting area to relax and listen to the sounds of nature just beyond the window. 

Outside you'll find wooded, private grounds complete with a moss fairy garden!  You'll also have some up close and personal moments with the many deer families that tend to happen by each day.  Spend as much time as you like wandering the property, or relax with a good book on the beautifully furnished back deck nestled in the woods.  You could always grill a fabulous meal for your crew and dine under the stars, then maybe even let us arrange a night for you and yours around the fire pit, complete with s'mores! Cabin Creek Farm is equipped with everything you could possibly need to enjoy your stay...and then some!

Guest access

The Cottage + Cottage patio are not included with the main house rental.  There is a separate listing called The Cottage at Cabin Creek Farm.

Inside you’ll find, not only a slate bed pool table and a full size ping pong table, but as you may have seen in our pictures, we have a golf driving range! Located just minutes from the historic Old Hickory Village, you’ll have easy access to local shops, dining, and recreational activities. With proximity to the lake, parks, and major highways, this home provides both a serene setting and easy commuting options.

Rainwater and runoff originating within the Old Hickory Lake watershed flow into a controlled segment of the Cumberland River, forming what is now known as Old Hickory Lake—a reservoir established by an Army Corps of Engineers dam in 1954. This reservoir and its surrounding watershed are dedicated to the memory of the nation’s seventh president, Andrew Jackson, affectionately nicknamed Old Hickory. Located just 15 miles from Nashville, Old Hickory Lake is a haven for various recreational pursuits such as camping, boating, fishing, swimming, hiking, cycling, and more.

Old Hickory is a residential enclave positioned along the shores of Old Hickory Lake. Once home to a DuPont gunpowder plant dating back to the 1900s, the neighborhood evolved around this industrial site. Today, the area boasts amenities like the Old Hickory Country Club, sandy Old Hickory Beach, soul food and sports bar restaurants. Furthermore, from spring to fall, visitors can indulge in shopping at the weekly Old Hickory Village Farmers Market. The capital of Tennessee, Nashville is otherwise known as "Music City". The birthplace of bluegrass, you’ll find plenty of music and attractions around virtually every corner including honky-tonks, the Johnny Cash Museum, and Music Row. It is also home to the Grand Ole Opry House, the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum, and Ryman Auditorium.

Best and Closest public golf course:

The President’s Reserve, designed by architect Denis Griffiths (designer Atlanta’s Chateau Élan Resort Courses), trails through 300 acres of natural Tennessee wetlands and along the banks of the beautiful Cumberland River. Playing up to 7200 yards, The President’s Reserve can offer any golfer as much challenge as one might desire yet be a pleasurable golfing experience for even the occasional golfer. The President’s Reserve has been recognized by Golf Digest Magazine as one of the Top 10 in Tennessee.

Places of interest in Old Hickory, TN:
•    Old Hickory Lake: A large reservoir created by the Old Hickory Dam on the Cumberland River, perfect for boating, fishing, and swimming. There are several parks along its shores, including Old Hickory Beach and Cedar Creek Recreation Area.
•    Old Hickory Lock and Dam: This historic structure is a great spot for fishing and provides scenic views of the lake and surrounding nature. There are also picnic areas nearby.
•    Hermitage, Home of Andrew Jackson: Located just a short drive from Old Hickory, this is the former estate of President Andrew Jackson. The museum and grounds offer a historical glimpse into the life of one of the U.S.'s early presidents.
•    Cumberland River: Old Hickory is situated along the Cumberland River, which provides opportunities for kayaking, paddleboarding, and fishing.
•    Long Hunter State Park: Located not far from Old Hickory, this state park offers miles of hiking trails, fishing spots, camping areas, and access to Percy Priest Lake.
•    Nashville Zoo: If you’re interested in wildlife, the Nashville Zoo is about a 30-minute drive from Old Hickory and offers a wide variety of animals, exhibits, and family-friendly activities

The space
Experience the energy of Music City from the comfort of this spacious and beautifully updated four-bedroom private retreat, conveniently located just about 20 minutes from Downtown Nashville. Perfect for families, groups of friends, and business travelers, this inviting home offers modern amenities, multiple indoor and outdoor gathering spaces, and easy access to the iconic music, dining, and entertainment that make Nashville one of the country’s most exciting destinations.

Step inside to discover a bright open-concept living space designed for relaxing and connecting. The welcoming living room features comfortable seating, a cozy gas fireplace, and a large 75” Smart TV, making it the perfect place to unwind after a day exploring the city. Large windows bring in natural light while creating a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout the main living area.

The fully equipped modern kitchen offers everything needed to prepare meals during your stay, including a stove, oven, refrigerator, dishwasher, and microwave. With generous counter space, counter-height seating, and a nearby dining area, the kitchen and dining spaces make it easy to gather for breakfast before heading downtown or enjoy a relaxed dinner together after a night on Broadway.

Each of the four bedrooms is thoughtfully furnished with crisp linens, plush pillows, and comfortable bedding, providing restful spaces for everyone in your group. The home’s layout offers both privacy and shared living space, making it ideal for longer stays or group trips.

Step outside to enjoy the home’s private outdoor areas, including a backyard, patio, and balcony with seating—perfect for morning coffee, evening conversation, or enjoying Nashville’s mild evenings. Additional conveniences include high-speed WiFi, an in-home laundry area, onsite parking, and keyless entry for a seamless and stress-free arrival.

The location places you within easy reach of Nashville’s most popular attractions. Spend the day exploring Broadway’s famous honky-tonks, tour the legendary Grand Ole Opry, or visit the Country Music Hall of Fame & Museum. Stroll the beautiful grounds of Cheekwood Estate & Gardens, take photos at the Parthenon in Centennial Park, or visit the Nashville Zoo. Music fans will also love discovering the Music City Walk of Fame, historic recording studios, and the city’s incredible live music venues.

Whether you’re visiting for a weekend of live music, a bachelorette trip, family vacation, or business travel, this comfortable Nashville home offers the perfect balance of space, convenience, and proximity to the heart of Music City.

Spacious, modern, and close to everything—your Nashville getaway starts here.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Nashville, known as the "Music City," is a vibrant and dynamic destination that offers something for everyone. From its rich country music heritage to its thriving culinary scene, arts, and outdoor attractions, Nashville is a place where Southern charm meets creative energy. Whether you're visiting for a weekend getaway, a music pilgrimage, or just to explore, here’s a guide to some of the best things to do in Nashville, TN.

1. Visit the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum
Nashville’s most iconic museum, the Country Music Hall of Fame, is a must-see for music lovers. With exhibits dedicated to the legends of country music, including Johnny Cash, Dolly Parton, and Hank Williams, the museum tells the rich history of the genre. Explore interactive exhibits, video installations, and memorabilia from country music’s golden age to present day.

2. Explore Broadway and the Honky-Tonks
The heart of Nashville’s nightlife scene, Broadway is a bustling street lined with bars, honky-tonks, and live music venues. Walk along the neon-lit strip, stop into famous venues like Tootsies Orchid Lounge, The Stage, and Robert's Western World, where you can enjoy live music all day and night. It’s the perfect spot for country music enthusiasts to experience the city’s musical roots.

3. Tour the Grand Ole Opry
The Grand Ole Opry is one of the most legendary music venues in the world. Founded in 1925, it’s the birthplace of country music and hosts weekly live radio broadcasts featuring country stars, up-and-coming artists, and musical legends. Take a backstage tour to see where the magic happens and, if you're lucky, catch a live performance.

4. Visit the Parthenon in Centennial Park
Nashville is home to a full-scale replica of the Parthenon in Athens, Greece, located in Centennial Park. This impressive structure houses an art museum and features a 42-foot statue of Athena. The park itself is a great place for a leisurely walk, picnicking, or enjoying outdoor activities like paddleboarding on the park’s scenic lake.

5. Experience the Johnny Cash Museum
The Johnny Cash Museum is a tribute to one of country music’s greatest legends. Located just a short walk from Broadway, this museum features an extensive collection of memorabilia, including Cash's personal letters, instruments, costumes, and recordings. The museum also showcases his musical journey and cultural impact, making it a must-visit for fans of the "Man in Black."

6. Walk Through Ryman Auditorium
The Ryman Auditorium is known as the “Mother Church of Country Music” and has hosted a wide range of artists, from Elvis Presley to modern-day stars. Take a guided tour to learn about its history and stunning acoustics, or catch a concert in this intimate and iconic venue. Its rich history and atmosphere make it a Nashville landmark you can't miss.

7. Explore the Nashville Zoo at Grassmere
If you're traveling with family, the Nashville Zoo at Grassmere is a fun and educational stop. Located just outside of downtown, it features over 2,700 animals, beautiful botanical gardens, and exhibits like the Tiger Exhibit, Giraffe Viewing, and the Discovery Center. It's a great way to spend a day outdoors with kids or animal lovers.

8. Stroll Through the Cheekwood Estate & Gardens
For a more tranquil escape, head to Cheekwood Estate & Gardens, a beautiful 55-acre botanical garden and art museum. Located just a short drive from downtown, it’s home to beautifully curated gardens, including a Japanese Garden, wildflower meadow, and rose garden. The estate also hosts rotating art exhibitions and seasonal events like holiday light displays and outdoor concerts.

9. Check Out the Music City Walk of Fame
The Music City Walk of Fame is a tribute to influential figures in music who have contributed to Nashville's legacy. The sidewalk along Demumbrian Street is lined with stars, similar to Hollywood’s Walk of Fame, honoring legends from all genres, not just country music. It’s a fun walk to take while exploring downtown.

10. Visit the Frist Art Museum
For art lovers, the Frist Art Museum is a stunning venue housed in a former post office building. The museum features rotating exhibits of local, national, and international art, ranging from contemporary pieces to more classical works. It also offers a variety of educational programs and events throughout the year.

11. Experience the Local Food Scene
Nashville’s food scene is booming, with everything from Southern comfort food to trendy fusion restaurants. Don’t miss trying hot chicken, a Nashville specialty, at spots like Hattie B’s or Prince’s Hot Chicken Shack. Explore the city’s food scene further by visiting Nashville Farmers’ Market, where you can enjoy fresh local produce, artisanal products, and regional cuisine.

12. Take a Cruise on the Cumberland River
Experience Nashville from the water with a riverboat cruise along the Cumberland River. Companies like Nashville Paddle Co. and the General Jackson Showboat offer scenic cruises with spectacular views of the downtown skyline, bridges, and riverfront attractions. Many of these cruises include live music, dinner, or brunch, adding a special touch to your Nashville experience.

13. Explore the Belle Meade Plantation
History buffs will enjoy visiting the Belle Meade Plantation, a historic mansion and former thoroughbred horse farm. Learn about the plantation’s history, including its role in the antebellum South and its world-famous racehorses. The property also includes a winery where you can enjoy a tasting after your tour.

14. Attend a Nashville Predators or Tennessee Titans Game
If you’re in Nashville during sports season, check out a Nashville Predators (NHL) hockey game at the Bridgestone Arena or a Tennessee Titans (NFL) game at Nissan Stadium. Nashville has a passionate sports community, and attending a game is a great way to experience the local energy and excitement.

15. Take a Walking Tour of Historic Germantown
Just north of downtown, Germantown is one of Nashville’s oldest neighborhoods and offers a lovely mix of history, architecture, and trendy shops and restaurants. Take a walking tour to learn about the area’s Civil War history, admire its historic Victorian homes, and stop for a bite at one of the neighborhood’s upscale eateries or bakeries.

Our home is designed for ultimate comfort and relaxation. This retreat features everything you need for a rejuvenating stay. We look forward to serving you as our guest.

The space
Our beautiful home is perfect for families or groups seeking a relaxing escape! Nestled in a peaceful neighborhood, our home comfortably accommodates up to 9 guests, making it ideal for family gatherings, reunions, or a weekend with friends.

Key Features:
Ample Sleeping Arrangements: 
The property boasts 3 bedrooms, that includes a large master suite with a king-size bed and private master bathroom with a Jacuzzi bathtub. There are two guest bedrooms with queen beds, a large bonus room with a modular sleeper sofa, and extra full-size mattresses. Fresh linens, essentials kit, washcloths, bath towels and other items are provided for your comfort. Each guest room has blackout curtains, a sitting area, charging stations, luggage rack and large closets.

Open-Concept Living Space: 
Enjoy quality time in the bright and airy living room that flows into the dining space. The well-equipped kitchen is perfect for cooking meals. The kitchen has modern appliances and all the essentials, including snacks, pots, pans, dinnerware, bakeware, Keurig coffee maker, choice of coffee, tea or hot chocolate, cookware, bowls/cups, utensils and more. Washer and dryer is also available.

Outdoor Oasis: 
Step outside to our spacious balcony, where you can unwind. It’s the perfect spot for morning coffee or evening stargazing. At night, don’t forget to plug in the outdoor string lights and enjoy the peace and quiet.

Family-Friendly Amenities: 
The property also features free Wi-Fi, free parking, luggage racks, smart TV's with apps in each room and fun games to play located in the large bonus room for entertainment. Games include Uno, Jenga, Checkers, Legos and more!

Dedicated Office Space: 
Our office workspace is ideal for freelancers, remote workers, or anyone needing a dedicated spot to focus on their projects. The workspace features a sturdy desk for your laptop and materials. We provide pens, stationery, and notepads to ensure you have everything you need right at your fingertips.

Convenient Location: 
Located just minutes from local attractions, restaurants, and airport, you’ll have easy access to everything you need for a memorable stay. 

Downstairs Layout:
The first level of the home contains a large living room, well equipped kitchen with breakfast nook with seating for 6, a large pantry, designated dining room with seating for 6, half bathroom, laundry facilities, access to the covered balcony, 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms and storage closets.

Upstairs Layout:
Walk up a short flight of stairs and you will find a large bonus room, office workspace and a comfortable modular sectional sofa that can be rearranged into another queen size bed to sleep 2, if needed. There are also 2 extra full-size mattresses with linens.

Nearby Grocery Stores: Sprouts, Kroger, Wal-Mart Supercenter, Publix, Aldi’s and Target.

You are only:
20 minutes drive to Music Row & The Gulch, Vanderbilt University, Belmont University, Lipscomb University, Broadway, Honky Tonks (Tootsie's, Nudie's, Nashville Underground), Ryman Auditorium, Nissan Stadium, Bridgestone Arena, Grand Ole Opry, Gaylord Opryland Resort, Opry Mills Mall and Music City Center.

15 minutes drive to BNA airport, Nashville Zoo, Cool Springs Galleria.

9 minutes drive to Tanger Outlet Mall.

If you need a recommendation for a place to shop or explore, let us know and we will be glad to offer suggestions.

Guest access
Guests will have 100% access to this home. No smoking or vaping of any kind while on the premises. Thanks.

Howdy,  I'm so delighted that you stopped by. I love my guests. Most answers to any questions or concerns can be found here. 

"NASHvegas getaway" provides southern hospitality at its best and with everything you need for an ultimate fun and relaxation holiday without ever having to leave the property. Pets weighing 40 pounds or less are welcome. Only 2 pets are permitted per stay.

The space
YOU MUST BE 27 OR OLDER TO BOOK MY HOME. 

Per my reviews, my home is always sparkling clean as we always clean the home with hospital grade cleaners. I am proud of my 5 stars for cleanliness. 

NASHvegas Getaway is a 2 bedroom home located in a quiet and upscale residential neighborhood of "Charlotte Park" which is considered as one of the best and safest neighborhoods in Nashville. It is one of two homes located on the same lot. I live part time in the 2nd home with my 2 small dogs. Neither home shares the same area. Nashvegas getaway is located within a few miles from downtown and other major establishments and area attractions. You'll find a large patio filled with extras like an inviting hot tub with curtains for privacy, an outdoor gas grill, comfortable loungers for relaxing  and many other amenities. The entire front yard is securely fenced in and reserved for guests and their pets only so no need to worry about them escaping. If you are more interested in kicking back indoors, then feel free to sink into the extra long and VERY comfortable down filled cushioned sofa. The kitchen is fully equipped to meet the needs of the most discriminating chefs. If not, let me know and I will do my darnedest to get it for you. There is a TV in every room in the house except the dining room with over 300 channels to choose from and satellite boxes that will allow you to record your own show if you like. I hope you will enjoy my large collection (over 350) of recorded movies or shows found on the DVR which include documentaries, comedies, western and various other genres except horror. A large portion of them are TCM Hollywood classics which is one of my guilty pleasures. If you are looking for an old black and white, there are plenty to choose from. When it's time to catch a good night of zzz's, you'll rest easily on a "top of the line mattress".  I receive many wonderful compliments on their comfort. My home is so comfortable and relaxing and every imaginable amenity is provided.  If not, I will do my darnedest to get it for you. 

My guests just love my fun, quirky and unique home. They tell me that it's a great place to hang out, relax and let their hair down. You will find that my "getaway" has its own delightful sense of humor and personality.  If you are looking for a wonderful place to spend some quality time with your loved ones and to make some lasting memories for years to come, then I welcome you here. I would love to have you. 

Directly behind the home is Charlotte Park. Great place for walking your dog or for getting a little exercise for yourself. Don't forget  your basketball and/or walking shoes. There is also a playground for your little ones (see photos).  

During the spring and summer months, be sure to visit "Rock Harbor Marina".  It's one of my favorite hangouts and is located within walking distance from the home. Be sure to check out the ever popular "Blue Moon Cafe" while there. It's a wonderful outdoor restaurant that sits on the water. You will enjoy listening to the live music, the great food, and watching the boats come and go. 

No matter how you are wanting to fill your time while you are in Nashville, you will find most activities and tourist attractions very nearby and at the same time, you can come "HOME" where the neighborhood is very safe, low traffic and peaceful. 
* Upon checkout, you will not be required to do more than your own dishes and proper disposal of trash and recyclables. 
* If you're a returning guest, military vet or a fellow Airbnb host, I gladly offer you a 10%  discount on your stay.

Guest access
You will have the entire house, patio area and the fenced in  front yard all to yourself.  I live onsite in a separate unit. Charlotte park is located a skip, hop and jump down the street which has access to a walking trail, basketball court and a playground for the kids. It’s a great place where you can enjoy a picnic, walk your dog, play a game of basketball and so much more.

Other things to note
*My home is dedicated to those individuals seeking a fun, safe, peaceful and quiet atmosphere for some rest and relaxation. Charlotte park is a quiet residential area with residents that live here full-time. Excessive noise will not be tolerated especially between the hours of 10:00PM and 8:00AM.  I like my wonderful neighbors and I am committed to making sure that they are not disturbed by my vacation rental guests. 
*Smoking is permitted on the patio only
*There's an additional fee of $20.00 for each guest per night after 2 people.
*Pet Policy: This is a pet-friendly dwelling provided your pooches and kitties are not noisy and do not engage in destructive behaviors. Please let me know if you are bringing a pet and be sure to include their breed and weight upon your initial contact with me. No aggressive dogs are permitted or those weighing over 40 pounds. I provide many items for your beloved doggy including a  medium size doggy door for getting in and out of the home, steps, gate, bed, sheets and towels. There is a fee of $50 for each pet. Only 2 pets are permitted. There will always be additional cleaning required after a pet has been in the home. We do a very thorough job and leave behind no trace of a pet ever being here. This will ensure that the next guests will enjoy the home without the inconvenience of pet smells or hair floating about. As a courtesy, if you are only staying 1 night and you have 2 pets, a one time fee of $50 will be sufficient for both. IMPORTANT! If you are bringing a pet. Please let me know the breed(s) and weight when booking.

Hi Future Guests!

My wife and I have loved this place since we bought it in 2009. It's a big house in a beautiful, hilly, safe, and family-oriented neighborhood that is less than 10 minutes from downtown Nashville and 15 from the airport.

It's got 3 bedrooms, one of which is very large, a big, bright living room with high ceilings, a beautiful pool table, a large back porch surrounded by woods, and a kitchen with concrete countertops that I poured myself (with the help of some session musicians you have definitely heard on the radio).

During the years that we were touring musicians, we rented the house out short-term while we were away and managed it ourselves. At some point we had a plumbing problem and it was very stressful trying to deal with it from far away, so we hired our friend Angie who works with an amazing local management company to look after the guests for us while we're out of town.

There are a few things to know about this place:
1. It is very well loved, large, and very clean, but it is not one of the new construction tall-and-skinnies you see on AirBnB. Much of the kitchen, the drywall, and the floors are new, but we're currently saving up to do the bathrooms and there's some 80s panelling we are itching to get rid of. If you want something large, personal, clean, and cheap then this place is for you. If you're looking for fancy then you probably want to spend a few extra dollars. Almost all of our guests have felt like they got more than their money's worth.

2. Occasionally we get a last-minute session we have to fly in for, and when that happens we'll grab our car out of the garage and stay with friends. The garage is in the unfinished basement and not connected to the rented living area -- so most people never notice, but it's possible you'll hear the garage open and close once during your stay.

3. It is a reasonably quiet neighborhood and if there's a loud party our neighbors will be giving us a call. That's only happened twice in 15 years -- they don't mind normal noise! So just use common sense -- hanging out in the front yard is fine, but blasting music late at night outside is something they will definitely call us about.

4. We love to hear ideas from guests about improving the place, so don't hold back! (That's how we got the pool table).

Please reach out to Angie if you have any issues during your stay (since she's near and we're far), and we hope you love Nashville!

Oh yeah -- some stuff we love in the city:
1. The Pharmacy Burger -- the best burgers in town and a big outside patio.
2. Centennial Park -- There's a life-size replica of the Parthenon and a great mile-long track if you like to run.
3. Burger Up -- It's a great, reasonably priced date-night.
4. Five Points Pizza -- the best NY style pizza
5. 3rd & Lindsley -- our favorite place to see touring and local music. There's always something good there. Especially the Time Jumpers.

Thanks and hope you enjoy your stay!
-Brian and Rachel

• Tennessee State University

There is LED strip lighting running along the inside frame of the Murphy bed with several color settings and is controlled with a remote.

description:
PETS WELCOME 💜 Backyard is fully fenced (6 foot) for dogs.

House is on the 56 bus line going to Nissan Stadium (2.3 miles away), pedestrian bridge to Broadway, etc. 

My adorable *renovated* '50s cottage has space for 4 (queen, twin, floor twin, pack n play for baby). Located in hip East Nashville in the heart of the city, but in a quiet neighborhood on a dead end street. Walking distance to bars, coffee shops and eateries. 

5 minute drive to 5 points and 8-12 minutes  to downtown!

The space
Merely 1.6 miles (5 min) from fun 5 Points, Riverside Village and Eastland and Porter areas, and 4 miles (12 min) from Broadway in downtown Nashville. Sits on the 56 bus line.

Rent the whole cottage to easily accommodate 3 adult travelers in dedicated beds (1 queen, 1 twin). Add more guests up to 4 adult people total if your group is comfortable with adding for sleeping arrangements the living room couch or a temperpedic twin size floor mattress provided for you. The maximum adult travelers allowed is 4.

Families with small children I am open to creative problem solving etc.  and understand that may mean more extra tiny humans. I have 1 pack-n'-play you can use that’s in the primary closet, you will need to set up and then take down and return to closet please.

The sunny office/ twin bedroom is sure to help you on your quick WFH check ins with the office during your stay.

The primary has a queen bed furnished with West Elm pieces and antiques. This room is a tranquil respite from city life--quiet and cozy.

In 2026 I renovated to add a full-size washer/dryer 2-in-1 to the home. 

All rooms have overhead fans in the house, and there is central AC/Heat too. I am pleased to stock your bathroom with bath products including shampoo, body wash, and conditioner.

Enjoy the deck and patio looking out on my large yard, an oasis of peace and just perfect for your morning cup of coffee or evening sunset glass of wine or bourbon. The deck is also a great spot to read a book, write a song, or practice yoga!  

Please note that the deck gets sap and leaves falling on it during autumn from the trees— a broom in the kitchen is available for your use and there are always cleaning sprays as well! It is impossible for me to keep the deck immaculate for each guest, but this Airbnb is priced accordingly with imperfections like that in mind. Yard is fully fenced, 6 foot.

*This is a pet friendly listing— you can definitely bring a pet with you but please do let me know in advance.

This house was my primary residence for many years before becoming full-time Airbnb. It is lived in and not a sterile hotel environment, but rather a cozy and cared for normal home. If you are looking for a brand new modern luxury experience...look elsewhere than my sweet home built in 1952. Please know yourself and your needs, and don't stay here if this home will not be a fit for you and your lifestyle. 

If you have dog allergies, please do not book my rental--the house will be clean but it's impossible for me to guarantee zero pet hair might be found somewhere, when this is a pet-friendly listing and two dogs lived here full-time for many years too in the past! I'd hate for a guest with terrible allergies to have a bad experience.

Guest access
-Free parking
-French Press or regular coffee machine or tea  daily, if desired 
-Wifi
-shampoo, conditioner and soaps
-Private deck and fully fenced backyard with various tables and seating areas 
-In winter (when trees are leafless) you can snag a bit of skyline view from the property
-has laundry unit
-has 1  pack n play for baby/toddler

Other things to note
For the visiting dog owners— yard is fully fenced and 6 feet high.

I live in an apartment on the property but physically separated from the house. I give guests their privacy in the house and backyard! I do not have any dogs any longer so you’ve got the yard to yourself. Sometimes I foster puppies but don’t use the backyard for them.

Want to check out the house? Take a peek and also share your pics with me on IG at sweeteastnashvillecottage. I’ve documented lots of renovation but haven’t updated in a few years there and need to.

Four stories above the city buzz, The Aerial sits on a clifftop in East Nashville where the Nashville skyline isn't a view you catch through a window - it's the backdrop to everything you do here. From the rooftop to the backyard fire pit, this home is built for groups of up to 12 who want more than a place to sleep between nights out.

Sleeping arrangements
Four bedrooms and nine beds give everyone their own space without anyone feeling squeezed. Bathrooms

Outdoor living
September in Nashville still carries warmth in the evenings, and The Aerial is set up to make the most of it. A paid pack 'n play/travel crib can be arranged on request. An in-unit washer and dryer, clothing storage with hangers, and an iron handle the practical side of a longer stay.

Getting around
Free parking on premises and free street parking make arrival straightforward. Self check-in via smart lock means you set your own schedule from the start, with a private entrance and no coordination required. Downtown Nashville is close when you want it - and far enough away that The Aerial feels like a proper retreat when you don't.

Safety
Exterior security cameras cover the decks and every exterior entrance to the house and driveway. A doorbell camera, smoke alarm, and carbon monoxide alarm are all in place.

Hester & Cook, A Village of Flowers, Impeccable Pig, Molly Green, Nash Collection, Peacock Jewelers, Posh, Rebecca James Clothing, Romantic Creations Bridal, SEE, The Spice & Tea Exchange, Tribe Kelley, UAL, and Wilder

BROADWAY:
Just a short 10-minute drive from our location, you'll find yourself in the heart of Nashville's famous Broadway Street! Bursting with energy, Broadway is home to the city's iconic Honky Tonk bars, making it Nashville's main attraction. As you wander through the lively street, you'll also find some of the city's most celebrated venues, including Bridgestone Arena, The Ryman Auditorium, Music City Center, and Titans Stadium. Whether you're catching a live show, exploring local shops, or grabbing a bite to eat, there’s no shortage of excitement. Plus, it’s all conveniently just a quick Uber ride away!

Property Permit Number: #2022001815

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire house, but one supply closet and two closets in the garage.

Home is equipped with two Yale smart locks. Guests will receive access code prior to stay. Access begins at 4pm day of check-in and access will expire 10am day of check-out unless arranged otherwise prior to stay.

Other things to note
FREE PARKING:
One car garage and one space in front of garage. Additional first come first serve parking (6 spaces) for the complex.

NO NASHVILLE OR LOCAL GUESTS: 
We do not allow locals on our property under any circumstances. We have a policy of not renting our home to individuals residing in Nashville or surrounding Metro area. We reserve the right to cancel any reservation made by a local resident without issuing a refund. If you are a local resident, please refrain from booking our home. Thank you!

CHILDREN DISCLOSURE:
We're delighted to welcome families with children to our home! However, it's crucial to mention that our home is not childproofed. With amenities like numerous stairs (4 story home), rooftop deck featuring a high ledge, additional balcony etc - we want to be up front and ensure a safe and enjoyable stay for everyone. For the safety of our youngest guests, we kindly request that children be supervised by an adult at all times.

12 GUEST/VISITOR MAXIMUM:
A maximum of 12 guests and visitors are allowed. Please state on your reservation the total number of guests (including any visitors, even if not staying the night). All guests and visitors must be pre-approved up front. No locals are allowed on our property.

4 STORY HOME W/ STAIRS:
Our home boasts four stories, a common architectural feature in many Nashville residences, contributing to breathtaking skyline views. To fully enjoy the charm of our space, please be aware that stairs are an integral part of your stay that each guests must use. The incredible view will make you forget about all the stairs. Please note bedroom #4 is located on a separate floor from a bathroom. Guests staying in this room will need to use a bathroom on a different level of the home. This set up is common in multilevel homes and may be ideal for those who don't mind a short walk to the bathroom.

NO SMOKING INSIDE:
To ensure a comfortable and healthy environment for all guests, smoking & vaping is strictly prohibited inside the property. This includes all indoor areas and on the rooftop deck. If you wish to smoke or vape, please do so outside in the backyard and dispose of cigarette butts responsibly. Violation of this policy may result in additional cleaning fees. Thank you for your understanding!

POTENTIAL NOISE:
Nashville is renowned for its vibrant atmosphere, particularly in the heart of the city. While our property offers a tranquil retreat, please be aware that you may experience occasional noise during your stay, such as from nearby construction, traffic, other neighboring Airbnb guests, and more. These factors are beyond our control. While we anticipate minimal disruption for most guests, it's important to note if you are unaccustomed to urban environments.

DOGS:
We happily welcome 1-2 well-behaved, house-trained adult dogs to stay in our home. We ask that all dogs be crated when left alone in our home, so please bring a crate with you. To ensure a smooth process, all dogs must be discussed and pre-approved by host within 24 hours of booking. Please be sure to add them to your reservation. $100 flat pet fee applies for up to two dogs. We regret to inform you that dogs under 1 year old, cats, or other animals are not allowed. Be please respectful and clean up after your dog(s) in our yard to avoid a fine. Any damage from pet will guests responsibility as an inspection will occur at check-out.
